brief: A tool caddy with a carry handle and divided bins for screws and bits.

requirements.evidence: 3x piece:0,0,0;full / 0,1,0;full / 1,0,0;full connected as triangle with 3 side-connectors, forming a portable caddy footprint
handle:1,0,0;top on cover:1,0,0;full;top with 3 inserts — centered on third cell for balanced carry

requirements.requirement: Divided bins for screws and bits
requirements.evidence: bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-div2 (2 compartments) for larger screws/bits and bin:0,1,0~hex-bin-full-div3 (3 compartments) for sorted small bits; both drop-in bins on remaining cells

finish.summary: Built 3-cell triangular caddy: two cells fitted with divided bins (2-way and 3-way) for screws/bits, third cell capped with cover-mounted carry handle. All cells linked with side-connectors; meshClash clear.

lines.key: pvc-section-double  (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))
lines.label: pvc-section-double (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))

cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
